game_title: Guess Until Right – Torchlit Cave Mouth Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth, the torchlit cave entrance: the torchbearer must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Guess Until Right: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints.
theme: Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth: the torchlit cave entrance
core_gameplay_loop: In Torchlit Cave Mouth, repeat each round: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints. Each round, a new crystal shards challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the guess_range value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 320 points of crystal shards by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 320, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Guess Until Right
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Guess Until Right' (Week 4 slot 7), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Torchlit Cave Mouth'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guess_range changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Torchlit Cave Mouth.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 320 within 80 seconds.
